title: Application Cutover: DNS Swap + Blue/Green Validation
description: Execute final application cutover using weighted DNS routing for blue/green validation.

steps.action: Run pre-cutover checklist: all services healthy on AWS target (Aurora, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, MSK, EKS/Amplify); K8s source still serving 100% traffic; rollback rehearsed
steps.verify: All AWS service health checks green; runbook printed; war room assembled; change window opens

steps.action: Create Route53 weighted routing policy: 90% to K8s (blue), 10% to AWS target (green) for canary validation
steps.verify: Route53 console shows weighted records; CloudWatch shows 10% traffic on AWS target; error rate = 0

steps.action: Monitor canary traffic (30 minutes): error rate, latency p50/p99/p999, database connections, cache hit rate
steps.verify: Error rate < 0.1%; latency within 20% of K8s baseline; no alerts firing in CloudWatch
steps.rollback: Set AWS target weight to 0; incident declared

steps.action: Shift to 50/50 then 100% AWS: update Route53 weights in 2 steps with 15-minute stability window between each
steps.verify: 100% traffic on AWS target; K8s cluster still running for emergency rollback
steps.rollback: Set AWS target to 0%, K8s to 100%

steps.action: Validate complete: application smoke tests pass; DMS CDC lag = 0 (no new writes to Oracle); stakeholder sign-off received; K8s decommission ticket filed
steps.verify: All smoke tests pass; DMS task stopped after 48h zero-lag confirmation; change request closed
steps.rollback: Only after 48h stability confirmed — K8s decommission is irreversible
